    (p, q, r) = (2, 4, 8) ∨ (p, q, r) = (3, 5, 15) := by
  have h₂ : p ≥ 2 := by
    linarith
  
  have h₃ : q ≥ 3 := by
    linarith
  
  have h₄ : r ≥ 4 := by
    linarith
  
  have h₅ : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by
    by_contra! h
    have h₅₁ : p ≥ 4 := by
      by_contra h₅₁
      have h₅₂ : p ≤ 3 := by linarith
      have h₅₃ : p = 2 ∨ p = 3 := by
        omega
      cases h₅₃ with
      | inl h₅₃ =>
        simp_all
      | inr h₅₃ =>
        simp_all
    have h₅₂ : (p - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by
      linarith
    have h₅₃ : (q - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 2 := by
      linarith
    have h₅₄ : (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by
      linarith
    have h₅₅ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
      calc
        (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
          gcongr <;> nlinarith
        _ = 3 * 2 * 3 := by rfl
    have h₅₆ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
    have h₅₇ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
      have h₅₇₁ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
      have h₅₇₂ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
        have h₅₇₃ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
          -- Use the fact that the divisor is less than or equal to the dividend
          have h₅₇₄ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
            -- Use the fact that the divisor is less than or equal to the dividend
            have h₅₇₅ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
            have h₅₇₆ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
              -- Use the fact that the divisor is less than or equal to the dividend
              have h₅₇₇ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ p * q * r - 1 := by
                -- Use the fact that the divisor is less than or equal to the dividend
                exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                  -- Prove that p * q * r - 1 is positive
                  have h₅₇₈ : (p : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
                  have h₅₇₉ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
                  have h₅₈₀ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
                  have h₅₈₁ : (p : ℤ) * q ≥ 16 := by nlinarith
                  have h₅₈₂ : (p : ℤ) * q * r ≥ 64 := by nlinarith
                  nlinarith
                ) h₅₇₅
              exact h₅₇₇
            exact h₅₇₆
          exact h₅₇₄
        exact h₅₇₃
      exact h₅₇₂
    have h₅₈ : p ≥ 4 := by linarith
    have h₅₉ : q ≥ 4 := by
      by_contra h₅₉
      have h₅₁₀ : q ≤ 3 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₁ : q < r := by linarith
      have h₅₁₂ : (p : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₃ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₄ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₅ : (p : ℤ) * q ≥ 4 * 3 := by nlinarith
      have h₅₁₆ : (p : ℤ) * q * r ≥ 4 * 3 * 4 := by nlinarith
      have h₅₁₇ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
        calc
          (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
            gcongr <;> nlinarith
          _ = 3 * 2 * 3 := by rfl
      nlinarith
    have h₅₁₀ : r ≥ 5 := by
      by_contra h₅₁₀
      have h₅₁₁ : r ≤ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₂ : q < r := by linarith
      have h₅₁₃ : q ≤ 3 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₄ : (p : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₅ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₇ : (p : ℤ) * q ≥ 4 * 3 := by nlinarith
      have h₅₁₈ : (p : ℤ) * q * r ≥ 4 * 3 * 4 := by nlinarith
      have h₅₁₉ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
        calc
          (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 3 * 2 * 3 := by
            gcongr <;> nlinarith
          _ = 3 * 2 * 3 := by rfl
      nlinarith
    have h₅₁₁ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) > p * q * r - 1 := by
      have h₅₁₁₁ : (p : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₁₂ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
      have h₅₁₁₃ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₂),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₂) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₃),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₁) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₅₁₁₃)]
    linarith
  
  have h₆ : p = 2 → (p, q, r) = (2, 4, 8) := by
    intro hp
    have h₆₁ : p = 2 := hp
    have h₆₂ : q = 4 := by
      have h₆₂₁ : p < q := h₀.2.1
      have h₆₂₂ : q < r := h₀.2.2
      have h₆₂₃ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
      have h₆₂₄ : p = 2 := h₆₁
      rw [h₆₂₄] at h₆₂₃
      have h₆₂₅ : (2 - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by simpa using h₆₂₃
      have h₆₂₆ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by simpa using h₆₂₅
      have h₆₂₇ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by linarith
      have h₆₂₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ q + 1 := by linarith
      have h₆₂₉ : (q : ℤ) < r := by linarith
      have h₆₃₀ : (q : ℤ) = 4 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₆₃₁ : q ≠ 4 := h
        have h₆₃₂ : q ≥ 5 := by
          by_contra h'
          have h₆₃₃ : q ≤ 4 := by linarith
          have h₆₃₄ : q = 3 ∨ q = 4 := by
            omega
          cases h₆₃₄ with
          | inl h₆₃₄ =>
            have h₆₃₅ : q = 3 := h₆₃₄
            rw [h₆₃₅] at h₆₂₆
            norm_num at h₆₂₆
            <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try {
              have h₆₃₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
              have h₆₃₇ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 6 := by
                by_contra h'
                have h₆₃₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 7 := by linarith
                have h₆₃₉ : (r : ℤ) * 3 ≥ 21 := by nlinarith
                have h₆₄₀ : (r : ℤ) * 3 + 5 ≥ 26 := by nlinarith
                have h₆₄₁ : (r : ℤ) * 3 + 5 > 0 := by nlinarith
                have h₆₄₂ : (r : ℤ) * 3 + 5 > 0 := by nlinarith
                omega
              interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₆₂₆ ⊢ <;> omega
            })
          | inr h₆₃₄ =>
            exfalso
            simp_all
        have h₆₃₅ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₃₂
        have h₆₃₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ q + 1 := by linarith
        have h₆₃₇ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 6 := by linarith
        have h₆₃₈ : (r : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 6 * (q - 1 : ℤ) := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₃₉ : (r : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) + (2 * q + 5 : ℤ) ≥ 6 * (q - 1 : ℤ) + (2 * q + 5 : ℤ) := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₀ : (6 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) + (2 * q + 5 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₁ : (6 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₂ : (q - 1 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₃ : (r : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₄ : (r : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) + (2 * q + 5 : ℤ) > 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have h₆₄₅ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by simpa using h₆₂₆
        have h₆₄₆ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by
          exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
            have h₆₄₇ : (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 > 0 := by
              have h₆₄₈ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₃₂
              have h₆₄₉ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 6 := by linarith
              nlinarith
            linarith
          ) h₆₄₅
        have h₆₄₇ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by
          exact h₆₄₆
        have h₆₄₈ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) > (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by
          have h₆₄₉ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₃₂
          have h₆₅₀ : (r : ℤ) ≥ q + 1 := by linarith
          have h₆₅₁ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 6 := by linarith
          have h₆₅₂ : (q - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by
            nlinarith
          have h₆₅₃ : (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by
            nlinarith
          have h₆₅₄ : (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≥ 4 * 5 := by
            nlinarith
          have h₆₅₅ : (2 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 < (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₆₄₉) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₆₅₁)]
          linarith
        linarith
      exact_mod_cast h₆₃₀
    have h₆₃ : r = 8 := by
      have h₆₃₁ : p < q := h₀.2.1
      have h₆₃₂ : q < r := h₀.2.2
      have h₆₃₃ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
      have h₆₃₄ : p = 2 := h₆₁
      have h₆₃₅ : q = 4 := h₆₂
      rw [h₆₃₄, h₆₃₅] at h₆₃₃
      have h₆₃₆ : (2 - 1 : ℤ) * (4 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (2 : ℤ) * 4 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₆₃₃
      have h₆₃₇ : (3 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 := by simpa using h₆₃₆
      have h₆₃₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₆₃₉ : r ≤ 4 := by linarith
        have h₆₄₀ : r = 4 := by
          omega
        have h₆₄₁ : (r : ℤ) = 4 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₄₀
        rw [h₆₄₁] at h₆₃₇
        norm_num at h₆₃₇
        <;> omega
      have h₆₃₉ : r = 8 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₆₄₀ : r ≠ 8 := h
        have h₆₄₁ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₃₈
        have h₆₄₂ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 15 := by
          by_contra h'
          have h₆₄₃ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 16 := by linarith
          have h₆₄₄ : (3 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 := h₆₃₇
          have h₆₄₅ : (3 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 := by
            exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
              have h₆₄₆ : (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 > 0 := by
                nlinarith
              linarith
            ) h₆₄₄
          have h₆₄₆ : (3 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 := h₆₄₅
          have h₆₄₇ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 16 := by linarith
          have h₆₄₈ : (3 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) > (8 : ℤ) * r - 1 := by
            nlinarith
          linarith
        have h₆₄₃ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 15 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₄₂
        have h₆₄₄ : r ≤ 15 := by exact_mod_cast h₆₄₃
        have h₆₄₅ : r ≥ 5 := by linarith
        interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₆₃₇ ⊢ <;> omega
      exact_mod_cast h₆₃₉
    have h₆₄ : (p, q, r) = (2, 4, 8) := by
      simp [h₆₁, h₆₂, h₆₃]
      <;> norm_num
      <;> aesop
    exact h₆₄
  
  have h₇ : p = 3 → (p, q, r) = (3, 5, 15) := by
    intro hp
    have h₇₁ : p = 3 := hp
    have h₇₂ : q = 5 := by
      have h₇₂₁ : p < q := h₀.2.1
      have h₇₂₂ : q < r := h₀.2.2
      have h₇₂₃ : (p - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ p * q * r - 1 := h₁
      have h₇₂₄ : p = 3 := h₇₁
      rw [h₇₂₄] at h₇₂₃
      have h₇₂₅ : (3 - 1 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₃
      have h₇₂₆ : (2 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₅
      have h₇₂₇ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₇₂₈ : (q : ℤ) < 4 := by linarith
        have h₇₂₉ : (q : ℤ) ≤ 3 := by linarith
        have h₇₃₀ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by
          have h₇₃₁ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by
            linarith
          linarith
        have h₇₃₁ : (q : ℤ) = 3 := by linarith
        have h₇₃₂ : q = 3 := by exact_mod_cast h₇₃₁
        rw [h₇₃₂] at h₇₂₆
        norm_num at h₇₂₆
        <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try {
          have h₇₃₃ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith
          have h₇₃₄ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 16 := by
            by_contra h'
            have h₇₃₅ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
            have h₇₃₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
            have h₇₃₇ : (2 : ℤ) * (3 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * 3 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₆
            have h₇₃₈ : (2 : ℤ) * (3 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * 3 * r - 1 := by
              exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                have h₇₃₉ : (3 : ℤ) * 3 * r - 1 > 0 := by
                  nlinarith
                linarith
              ) h₇₃₇
            nlinarith
          interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₇₂₆ ⊢ <;> omega
        })
        <;>
        omega
      have h₇₃ : (q : ℤ) = 5 := by
        by_contra h
        have h₇₃₁ : q ≠ 5 := h
        have h₇₃₂ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by exact_mod_cast h₇₂₇
        have h₇₃₃ : (q : ℤ) ≤ 15 := by
          by_contra h'
          have h₇₃₄ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 16 := by linarith
          have h₇₃₅ : (2 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := h₇₂₆
          have h₇₃₆ : (2 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by
            exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
              have h₇₃₇ : (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 > 0 := by
                have h₇₃₈ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 16 := by linarith
                have h₇₃₉ : (r : ℤ) ≥ q + 1 := by linarith
                nlinarith
              linarith
            ) h₇₃₅
          have h₇₃₇ : (2 : ℤ) * (q - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) > (3 : ℤ) * q * r - 1 := by
            have h₇₃₈ : (q : ℤ) ≥ 16 := by linarith
            have h₇₃₉ : (r : ℤ) ≥ q + 1 := by linarith
            have h₇₄₀ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h₇₃₈) (sub_nonneg.mpr h₇₄₀)]
          linarith
        have h₇₄ : q ≤ 15 := by exact_mod_cast h₇₃₃
        have h₇₅ : q ≥ 4 := by linarith
        interval_cases q <;> norm_num at h₇₂₆ ⊢ <;>
          (try omega) <;>
          (try {
            have h₇₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by linarith
            have h₇₇ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 16 := by
              by_contra h'
              have h₇₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
              have h₇₉ : (2 : ℤ) * (4 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * 4 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₆
              have h₈₀ : (2 : ℤ) * (4 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * 4 * r - 1 := by
                exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                  have h₈₁ : (3 : ℤ) * 4 * r - 1 > 0 := by
                    nlinarith
                  linarith
                ) h₇₉
              nlinarith
            interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₇₂₆ ⊢ <;> omega
          }) <;>
          (try {
            have h₇₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by linarith
            have h₇₇ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 16 := by
              by_contra h'
              have h₇₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
              have h₇₉ : (2 : ℤ) * (5 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * 5 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₆
              have h₈₀ : (2 : ℤ) * (5 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * 5 * r - 1 := by
                exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                  have h₈₁ : (3 : ℤ) * 5 * r - 1 > 0 := by
                    nlinarith
                  linarith
                ) h₇₉
              nlinarith
            interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₇₂₆ ⊢ <;> omega
          }) <;>
          (try {
            have h₇₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by linarith
            have h₇₇ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 16 := by
              by_contra h'
              have h₇₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
              have h₇₉ : (2 : ℤ) * (6 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * 6 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₆
              have h₈₀ : (2 : ℤ) * (6 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * 6 * r - 1 := by
                exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                  have h₈₁ : (3 : ℤ) * 6 * r - 1 > 0 := by
                    nlinarith
                  linarith
                ) h₇₉
              nlinarith
            interval_cases r <;> norm_num at h₇₂₆ ⊢ <;> omega
          }) <;>
          (try {
            have h₇₆ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 5 := by linarith
            have h₇₇ : (r : ℤ) ≤ 16 := by
              by_contra h'
              have h₇₈ : (r : ℤ) ≥ 17 := by linarith
              have h₇₉ : (2 : ℤ) * (7 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ∣ (3 : ℤ) * 7 * r - 1 := by simpa using h₇₂₆
              have h₈₀ : (2 : ℤ) * (7 - 1 : ℤ) * (r - 1 : ℤ) ≤ (3 : ℤ) * 7 * r - 1 := by
                exact Int.le_of_dvd (by
                  have h₈₁ : (3 : ℤ) * 7 * r - 1 > 0 := by
                    nlinarith
                  linarith
                ) h₇₉
              nlinarith
